Pandora must face a federal copyright suit over two medallion designs in its Talisman collection. Judge Colleen McMahon denied Pandora's motion to dismiss on 10 September, ruling the designs could be substantially similar to FoundRae's Balance and Passion medallions. The order decides nothing about infringement, only that the claim survives. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

De Beers cuts a diamond screening scan from 30 minutes to under five with SynthDetect 2. The instrument needs less operator input, shown at Hong Kong's Gem and Jewellery Show. It follows SynthDetect XL by eight years, the longest gap in the line, with no price published. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
